scope: Original 2020 Dune: Imperium base/core standard 2–4-player multiplayer, including required two-player House Hagal. Excludes solo, optional variants, expansions, promos and Uprising.
conclusion: No material rules error or important omission identified against the supplied authoritative rulebook, original Harvest Spice card asset and applicable January 13, 2025 official FAQ. The summary correctly incorporates later FAQ timing and distinguishes ordinary third place from tied-second rewards.

source_review.rulebook: Read complete extracted text; reviewed in-scope rulebook PDF pages 1–19. Page 20 is solo-only and excluded. Inspected rendered component/setup/board, leader/card and icon diagrams where the extraction omitted text or symbols.
source_review.official_faq: Read all four pages via supplied column-aware extraction, filtering out expansion/promo/Uprising-only entries and clauses.
source_review.card_asset: Visually inspected complete local publisher Harvest Spice JPEG and matched its illustration with rulebook PDF p.19.

limitations: The supplied rulebook/FAQ do not reproduce the complete printed Machinations first-place reward. Its specific Choose two wording could not be directly confirmed from these inputs; the distinction between separate one-Influence choices and one unsplittable gain-two Influence effect is consistent with the rulebook icon guide. No contradictory source evidence was found.
